_comment: The machine-readable work queue. tools/bm_idle.py reads THIS file and nothing else to answer whether the machine is about to sit idle. Depth is the count of items in state 'queued'. Ordering is the array order: the next item to start is the first 'queued' item. An item is startable only if it needs no founder answer; anything that does carries state 'blocked' with a reason and is NOT counted toward depth, because a blocked item cannot save a night. Edit by hand or with bm_idle.py mark.

items.title: P0 The install suite is killed at the 900 second SILENCE budget while it is still making progress, three times in one night. ROOT CAUSE PROVEN 2026-08-16 and it is not what the first review guessed: tools/test_all.py reads the child by LINES (for line in p.stdout) while unittest writes one dot per test with NO newline, so a whole suite emits no complete line until its dot row ends. Any suite whose row takes longer than the budget reads as silent and is killed with 0 tests. Disproven on the way: adding -u changes nothing, both buffered and unbuffered first reached the reader only when a newline arrived (measured, 3.03s in both arms). Fix candidates: read by chunk instead of line, or run suites at verbosity 2 so each test emits its own line. The .claude copytree exclusion already landed and is worth keeping on its own merits but did NOT fix this
items.done_check: a suite that runs longer than the budget while emitting dots is NOT killed, proven by a fixture suite that sleeps past the budget and still reports its real test count

items.title: a task created through the CLI can never be served by next: task add writes status planned and next reads only ready, so the guided flow's own handoff from planning to work is broken

items.title: a task may be born in any of the ten lifecycle states because cmd_task_add passes --status straight through, so the ordering law the whole method rests on is bypassed by one flag

items.title: acceptance checks enforce nothing: the criterion link is opt-in, so a review that names no criterion verifies a task whose acceptance checks were never examined

items.title: the capability detector cannot tell installed from absent in either direction: it reads only ~/.claude/skills and the plugin caches, so it reports DEGRADE for a class the harness already ships built in, and would wrongly call the method stage empty
items.done_check: a class whose capability ships with the harness reports RESOLVED or reports NO-DATA naming what it cannot see, never a bare DEGRADE
